visualReview.scope: Static exterior rendering and geometry integrity at the ten captured views.
visualReview.notes: Inspected fresh preview, four turntables, near tower/deck/hangers, under-deck and full crossing. Resolved coplanar pier-band stippling and four lower hanger sockets intersecting tower legs. Parapets, cable clamps and socket hardware remain visible in close views; distant 50 mm hangers are subpixel and alias. Whole-crossing and end-on turntables establish completeness only, not fine detail acceptance.

geographicReview.notes: Original M48 identity is confirmed. Horizontal endpoint/axis and road fit need site review. Published tower and roadway heights use incompatible or incompletely specified datums; Y=0 is an unresolved local water reference and must not be treated as checked terrain or sea-level elevation.

fidelityReview.notes: Detailed original exterior reconstruction, not survey-grade maximum fidelity. Resolve primary hanger-count discrepancy, final section dimensions and vertical profile, common vertical datum, modern replacement hanger dimensions, texture/weathering treatment, adaptive cable visibility and collision/LOD work before full acceptance.
